name: What is the difference between post-remodel painting and a standard interior paint job?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between post-remodel painting and a standard interior paint job?

acceptedAnswer.text: Post-remodel painting differs from a standard interior paint job primarily in the level of surface preparation required. A remodel often leaves behind construction dust, new drywall, patched areas, and possibly new trim or architectural elements that require meticulous cleaning, filling, and sanding to achieve a smooth, uniform surface. Standard interior painting typically involves less intensive preparation, focusing more on refreshing existing painted surfaces. The goal for both is a flawless finish, but the scope of work leading up to the painting itself is more extensive post-remodel.
acceptedAnswer.description: Post-remodel painting requires more intensive surface preparation due to construction debris and new surfaces compared to a standard interior paint job.
